recorded.outcome:q-drain-then-reschedule: Interrupting a Thread Sets a Flag...: 'Thread.interrupted() reads the flag and clears it. The inner loop saw the request and ended its batch, and in doing so erased the request. The outer loop's check then found nothing'. Also: 'never in a check that someone above you also relies on.' Same shape as the stem, so the caller's isInterrupted() reads false and it reschedules.

recorded.outcome:q-poll-catch-warns: A Blocking Call Answers by Throwing...: a blocked waiting method 'returns at once by throwing InterruptedException'. The sleep demo prints 'in the catch, isInterrupted() = false'. The 'log and go on' sender has the stem's exact shape (while(!isInterrupted) + catch that logs) and is 'still running after 1 s'; 'the while reads false forever'.
recorded.prompt:q-sleep-after-ignored-interrupt: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sleep-after-ignored-interrupt: independent readers: a page-free reader (round 4, wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-sleep-after-ignored-interrupt: A Blocking Call...: 'or is already interrupted when it calls one, the method returns at once by throwing InterruptedException'. 'Left set, the flag would make every later blocking call in the thread throw again.' Reference: 'A thread whose flag is already set when it enters one of the first three rows throws at once'. Flag section: a computing thread 'never notices a boolean that nobody reads', so the flag stays set.
